title: Keyframes to Video Flow: animate a set of pictures (drawings, 3D key poses, storyboard panels) on LTX 2.3 or MiniMax H3
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-1134 - Story and Infinite Video. Plan: tasks/MPI-1134/plan.md. Fabio 2026-10-24: NOT in the LTX 2.5 release (too big for it; Storyboard MPI-1231 ships alone). Design decided 2026-10-24 (brief.md DECIDED section) still holds. Joined 2026-10-19 (Fabio, umbrella pass). Widened 2026-10-21 (Fabio): LTX 2.3 takes keyframes too (LTXVAddGuide), so the Flow offers both models; 4-5 pictures or more; Storyboard Flow MPI-1231 panels are one input.  Idea, not a blocker (Fabio, 2026-10-18). Users with drawings or 3D animation that has only the main key poses drop in N pictures, set how many frames each one covers (a slider per picture), write one prompt; H3 makes the in-betweens. One MiniMaxH3AddGuide per picture at its frame_idx. Mid-shot / many-anchor runs are unproven: the MPI-1134 Phase 3 keyframe bench comes first. Brief: tasks/MPI-1191/brief.md.
